title: It looked way too easy… until I tried beating my own score
author: JirayaaaBoyy106
selftext:
Made this as a small casual mobile game and I’ve been testing how far I can push the “one more try” feeling.

The controls are simple. The difficulty… not so much.

I’m curious what people here think before I keep adding more levels/content.

Would you give this a try? 👇

Game : [Yum Merge ](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.threezerocompany.foodmerge)
